products.title: 3D-Printed Image Display
products.blurb: Your image in layered-filament color across modular panels — hex, circle, or square. Made to order.
products.description: Your photo or artwork turned into a 3D-printed display — built up from layers of colored filament for real depth and rich color (the technique's called HueForge). Individual panels tile into one piece in your choice of shape: hexagon, circle, or square. Each panel ships ready to hang — mounting bracket, command strips, and magnets installed. $40 per panel plus a one-time $35 image processing fee; pick your shape and panel count at checkout, then email your image + order number to hello@sqrrlbrain.com and I'll confirm it'll work before printing. Custom pieces are final, but if an image can't be made to work I'll refund it.
products.leadTime: made to order — ships in ~1–2 weeks
